notes.title: Demo Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey there, awesome gang:

Hope you are having a great one, shifting your way out of Neo Barcelona in one piece! A hell of a task to accomplish these days, we know. But rest assured, Jack has some tricks up her sleeve…
And we have some improvements and fixes to make things just a little easier in these streets.

Let's get down to business.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/f461d52396b5ed25d82a056a4b66df3640a190e8.gif

⬆️ Updates:

Increased the speed of the Quantum Blade!!
Reduced the size of the mini-map to improve screen visibility

🛠️ Bug Fixes:


 Fixed Issue where game could get stuck on loading screen.
 Fixed issue where the Pulverator's Boss death sound effect would trigger every time Jack entered the boss room.
 Fixed issue where the timed door in Spaceport would reset upon Jack dying after completion.
 Fixed issue where VERA would get stuck in place upon a new activation when going back to Jack in while hacking something.
 Fixed Issue where you get a black screen when rescuing Harry after switching language.
 Fixed Issue where the game might skip some inputs during fast parkour.
 Fixed issue where some item pop-up would not appear.
 1x1 Spikes now do damage as intended.

 Fixed visual issue where some enemy bullets would appear incorrectly on-screen during the intro cutscene.
 Fixed visual issue where the camera wouldn't follow VERA inside the Esperanza.
 Fixed visual issue where the crucible room in Spaceport would show as a long vertical room on the map.
 Fixed Visual Issue where UI disappears during Romance Dialogues.
 Fixed visual issue where the tutorial for the Quantum Shift in the Simulation would show incorrect button prompts.
 Fixed flicker on the Mod screen.

 Fixed Scroll functionality on the Data Tab.
 Fixed prompt where Health Cores where describes ad Health upgrades on the RoboDoc.
 Fixed Multiple Text formatting issues.

See you in our next entry,

notes.title: [NEW] File #17 // August Update + Gamescom Recap
notes.notes:
Hey there, awesome gang:
 Summer is coming to a close nicely, awesome events have come and go, but don’t worry! There’s still plenty of time to crack open a cold one with your crew and enjoy the view and the warmth of the cityscape.
We’ve been hard at work on Altered Alma, and we’re excited to share what’s new. So let’s dive right in!
Back from Gamescom 2025! 🎮
What a week, what a ride! Metroidvanias are back on business.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/49ee21cd172fd433605b853bd2c5e69975fb3aad.png"]

Gamescom 2025: Mission Accomplished! We are back from Germany, and it was a week to remember, for sure! We’ve heard you, the new demo of Altered Alma was awesome, Jack’s never looked so fine shifting and dashing across the neon-drenched corners of Spaceport.
Seeing all of you (SO MANY of you too) hitting the streets of Neo Barcelona, uncovering new secrets and beating new threats was such an experience. As always, we’ve felt the love of the community, and we can’t thank you enough for following us along this incredible journey, in person, online or wherever we might be. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/9101454bdb9b94d182b81a7e39fdc783aec99d32.png"]

A huge thank you to everyone who flew all the way to Cologne to try the new demo, share some kind words, or just came to say hi. Your support truly means the world to us. ⚔️

And let’s not forget about the awesome games and friends we were surrounded by at the Indie Arena Booth! We would like to thank the wonderful people of the organization, Valentina, and all the volunteers that helped us out. And special thanks to Catalan Arts, we wouldn’t make this possible with all of your support.
Shout out to the awesome people making RoomBattle, Blightstone, GodsTV, Dracamar… The Spanish indie scene is thriving, for sure. ❤️‍🔥

TUNE IN CRITICAL REFLEX TIME ON SEPTEMBER 15!
Our Publisher Critical Reflex will be hosting their own game show! From new trailers to development insights and updates – all delivered directly into your system.
[previewyoutube=iCzpE-6UHQI;full][/previewyoutube]
New demos, playtests, and releases. Also check it out for some Altered Alma news and announcements. Tune in Today (September 15th) at 7pm CEST / 10am PT / 1pm ET / 6pm BST

Watch the Showcase here!!




Development Progress 🛠️
🌆 A living, breathtaking city
[img src="https://i.imgur.com/cgc6DQm.gif"]
One day, you think you know this city like the back of your hand, the next, you could swear the building are moving on their own.
We are working hard on delivering the biggest, brightest and astonishing views you could ever imagine of this city. Neo Barcelona is being dressed for the occasion: better lighting, more and more neon signs, people walking around the streets and even Zeppelins flying in the night sky. What a sight!

🗡️ Up your arsenal
[img src="https://i.imgur.com/X4tIYam.gif"]
Jack’s been training hard off-screen to ensure she can beat each an every thug that dares crossing her path on these streets.
Soon you will be able to get your hands on some sweet new tools for the trade. Thinking of backstabbing your enemies and ending the thing in one fell swoop? Think no more. Maybe you have a more forward mentality about your problems? Well, we have the solution for you too.

⚔️ The bigger they are, the harder they fall
[img src="https://i.imgur.com/312d22w.gif"]
Jack’s been on the run for long enough. It was just a matter of time the Crusaders send somebody to hunt her down.
There is no place to hide in the depths of Spaceport. The perfect spot for waiting on your prey, but who’s to say which one will take the upper hand in this brutal encounter? Prepare yourself, old man.

A huge shoutout to everyone who’s been active on our Discord, giving us your love, support and feedback. Your input has been invaluable, helping us fine-tune the game to make it even better. We’ve been writing down notes like crazy, and we can’t wait to put them to good use as we polish up the final game.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/5e11844cc2fede2df446da84d01b3abda894c640.png"]

And a special thanks to all the brave souls who’ve already taken Neo Barcelona for a spin and shared their honest thoughts with us in the previous events – you rock!

notes.title: File #16 // July Update + Gamescom
notes.notes:
Hey there, awesome gang:



Summer is here!!—So is the heat, remember to stay hydrated! Can you believe we’re already halfway through the year? Time’s flying faster than Jack dashing going for some Burritos!





We’ve been hard at work on Altered Alma, and we’re excited to share what’s new. So let’s dive right in!

 



✈️ Back at Gamescom!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/2b0f680e890dd9a062efd7da92212129b4e40202.png"]

We’re thrilled to announce that we’ll be at Gamescom 2025! And of course, we’re not coming empty-handed.


🎮 Visit us at Hall 10.2, Booth F010g - E019

You’ll be able to play a totally new and never seen before demo of Altered Alma! Who knows what new secrets Neo Barcelona has in store…

Come say hi, chat with the team, and try the game for yourself!


⛩️ From Neo Barcelona to Kyoto
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/4217e2afb32f007fd435cb76f9bf95224cc80af4.png"]

BitSummit was a completely unforgettable experience for us! We had the incredible opportunity to showcase Altered Alma alongside other exciting indie games out there. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/0fddd35f5f470fbe96fb7abca327c80dbd22243c.jpg"]



Seeing players experience our game firsthand and getting direct feedback from the community was truly inspiring. Thank you, everyone, for your love and support during this amazing week! 

From the players who tried it out to the press who covered us up and made some noise about us! We truly appreciate it.



Take a look for yourself (if you are fluent in Japanese):

Game*Spark // 「ネオ・バルセロナ」で恋もバトルもグロも味わえる！メトロイドヴァニアにADV要素が加わったSF『Altered Alma』【BitSummit the 13th】

4Gamer // サイバーパンクな近未来のバルセロナが舞台のメトロイドヴァニアACT「Altered Alma」をプレイ［BitSummit

Gaming Matome // ネオ・バルセロナで紡がれるSF群像劇『Altered Alma』が描く未来

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/cb2b9374c291c0ac8ca9b530724cf53982604c7b.png"]


🐶 Pet the Pets!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/e8b2ff7132f8d59675ecdb2602af1df8b6342193.gif"]

Soon, you’ll be able to bring some furry companions aboard The Esperanza!

We’re beyond excited to let you pet these adorable babies. What would you name them?

Who would you pet first? Why not both? Jack has two hands, after all.


🌲 Meet the Vynefolk
We’ve also been expanding the world of Neo-Barcelona—here’s a little peek at two Vynefolk enemies you’ll come across during your journey:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/f70e4ea5b7618835069bf55be4bae0ba68a10812.png"]

The Vynefolk are an ancient species known for their calm and philosophical nature. They usually avoid conflict and keep to themselves, but if the Great Vyne is threatened, they won’t hesitate to strike back, fast and without mercy.


A huge shoutout to everyone who’s been active on our Discord, giving us your love, support and feedback. Your input has been invaluable, helping us fine-tune the game to make it even better. We’ve been writing down notes like crazy, and we can’t wait to put them to good use as we polish up the final game.

And a special thanks to all the brave souls who’ve already taken Neo Barcelona for a spin and shared their honest thoughts with us in the previous events – you rock!

notes.title: File #15 // June Update
notes.notes:
Hey there, awesome gang!!



Summer is here!!—So is the heat, remember to stay hydrated! Can you believe we’re already halfway through the year? Time’s flying faster than Jack dashing going for some Burritos!



We’ve been hard at work on Altered Alma, and we’re excited to share what’s new. So let’s dive right in!
 
Development Progress 🛠️

⚔️ Jack’s Combat Evolution
[img src="https://i.imgur.com/K2U4jT1.gif"]

The stomp attack isn’t just for breaking weak floors anymore. It’s a legit combat tool! Use it to damage and scatter enemies when they swarm you. Pro tip: the higher the fall, the bigger the boom.

🚫 Barriers? Not a Problem
[img src="https://i.imgur.com/SzaR7Ce.gif"]
Barriers are made to stop you and keep you away… Or that’s the idea. 

Because the Quantum Blade know no limit. Shift through the energy barriers to reach new levels, you can take advantage of its solidity to hold on them and its quantic weakness to go through them when you need to.


🔥 New Environmental Hazards & Enemies💀 Toxic Bubbles
[img src="https://i.imgur.com/Uo7kc6n.gif"]

Like a hot knife through butter—wait.



There’s really no place safe down here, these toxic bubbles seem weak at first sight, but pack a punch, make sure you avoid them, or you’ll end in a puddle of your own tears, or in this case, all the waste of the city recollected.

💢 Spiked Crushers
[img src="https://i.imgur.com/HqiF7JW.gif"]
Introducing the giant spiked crushers, going under Spaceport doesn’t mean that will be an easy path… Lots of mechanical parts moving might become a death trap if you aren’t careful enough. Be aware of your surroundings and think fast, or you will become a tortilla in a split of a second. And beware of those who are also hiding, they don’t like to share their spot.

🐀 Undercity’s Wildlife?
[img src="https://i.imgur.com/874IugC.gif"]

Seems like VERA made a new friend, a very twisted and mutated one. 

Undercity is plagued by multiple radioactive wildlife, they may look cute… but you’re still in Neo Barcelona, not every friend-shaped is a friend.

🍺Join us in the Undercity!
Welcome one and all to Neo Barcelona’s biggest and shameless bar zone, take a seat! This rat infested—neon drenched—slimy grounded zone will teach you the very definition of scrapping the bottom of the barrel. Here you will find every person that had their troubles up there in the city, so be aware and don’t be surprised if they dislike the idea of moving up in the world.

[img src="https://i.imgur.com/vteRYia.gif"]

Long story short, the place is run by The Harlequins, a motley crew of assorted humans and aliens, just your average gang of gangs, who in hell taught these guys the true meaning of organized crime…? 

A district almost forgotten by the people of Neo Barcelona, some might say you’re wasting your time going down here, there’s simply nothing of value to be gained, and too much to lose.




Dev Update: June Progress 📅
We improved the Spaceport area, updating the visuals and level design.

New enemies and environmental hazards have been implemented.

Some bosses have been spotted fighting Jack in the city.

Parc Güell has been improved, updating the visuals and level design.

Las Ramblas has been improved, updating the visuals and level design.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/af8ff0d06c00649d5c7d0ec558e3ef0bfeccfeca.png"]

A huge shoutout to everyone who’s been active on our Discord, giving us your love, support and feedback. Your input has been invaluable, helping us fine-tune the game to make it even better. We’ve been writing down notes like crazy, and we can’t wait to put them to good use as we polish up the final game.



And a special thanks to all the brave souls who’ve already taken Neo Barcelona for a spin and shared their honest thoughts with us in the previous events – you rock!

notes.title: File #14 // May Update + Guadalindie Recap
notes.notes:
Hey there, awesome gang:
We hope spring is treating you well—with sunshine, good vibes, and maybe a picnic or two! Can you believe we’re almost halfway through the year? Time’s flying faster than Jack dashing through Neo Barcelona!
We’ve been hard at work on Altered Alma, and we’re excited to share what’s new. So let’s dive right in!

Málaga was great!!
Looking back at GuadalIndie 2025?!
Mission accomplished! GuadalIndie 2025 was an unforgettable experience. Meeting so many of you in person, sharing the floor with other amazing indie games, and feeling the love from the community—it was all simply incredible. 💜 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/8c35b12d033712ecdd876bd25a84b052026e84cd.jpg
A huge thank you to everyone who stopped by our booth, shared kind words, or just came to say hi. Your support truly means the world to us.
Thanks so much for all your love and support—it means the world to us seeing you at events, cheering us on, and being part of this journey. 💜 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/464e09afecc8cd3868b465a9d3b71fbcb850ad8e.jpg

Development Progress
🧪 Welcome back to Parc Güell…
Get ready to explore one of the most striking areas in Altered Alma—Parc Güell. Inspired by Antoni Gaudí’s iconic real-world park, this biome offers a vibrant burst of lush greenery and surreal, organic architecture. Twisting pathways, hidden secrets, and dreamlike structures create a striking contrast to Neo Barcelona’s usual cyberpunk sprawl.
https://media.giphy.com/media/jWAnGZBNsu6gIwmVbn/giphy.gif
Parc Güell is home to the Shallari, a fiercely orthodox community who have rejected the neon-soaked ways of the outside world. Centered around their communal egg nest, the Shallari live with one single purpose: to protect the purity and survival of their kind—at any cost.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/0eb2dfd0238030234617e0c146affe36d1ee3e2a.png
Brutal, dogmatic, and deadly, many Shallari can recite twenty-six different ways to kill a person, but might not know how to make a sandwich. They shun cybernetics, considering both augmentation and exile equally impure. Those who leave Parc Güell often embrace the very tech their kin despise, becoming a divisive presence among the Shallari diaspora.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/7e5f51409220a131b22097bc5aa64b538b4468a7.png
🧑‍🚀 Waiting for you!
Red Rosie, the best armorer of Neo Barcelona gets bored a little easy, if she’s not fighting, you may find her making, tweaking or upgrading the weaponry system on the ship. Will you say hi to Rosie?
Here is a quick shot of our favorite Psycho armorer. ❤️
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/57c49ce8a21cf13550acfe36f4d311f992e41b72.gif
Dev Update: May Progress

	We improved the Spaceport area, updating the visuals and level design.
	New enemies and environmental hazards have been implemented.
	Some bosses have been spotted fighting Jack on the city.
	Parc Güell has been improved, updating the visuals and level design.
	Las Ramblas has been improved, updating the visuals and level design.


A huge shoutout to everyone who’s been active on our Discord, giving us your love, support and feedback. Your input has been invaluable, helping us fine-tune the game to make it even better. We’ve been writing down notes like crazy, and we can’t wait to put them to good use as we polish up the final game.
And a special thanks to all the brave souls who’ve already taken Neo-Barcelona for a spin and shared their honest thoughts with us in the previous events– you rock!

notes.title: File #13 // April Update + GualdalIndie
notes.notes:
Hey there, awesome gang:
We hope spring is treating you well—with sunshine, good vibes, and maybe a picnic or two! Can you believe we’re almost halfway through the year? Time’s flying faster than Jack dashing through Neo Barcelona!

We’ve been hard at work on Altered Alma, and we’re excited to share what’s new. So let’s dive right in!

Sun, Beach and Indies!!
We’re heading to Malaga!
Yup, it’s time to soak up the sun and indie game goodness at GuadalIndie 2025!

Thanks so much for all your love and support—it means the world to us seeing you at events, cheering us on, and being part of this journey. 💜 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/d57dcc820ab519cdc6a9d1a4f169a9c4154f1c86.jpg

📍 We’ll be at the Palacio de Ferias y Congresos de Málaga
📅 May 16–17

If you’re near Málaga, come say hi! We’d love to meet you and show you the latest from Altered Alma.

Development Progress
🧪 New Dangers Below…
The deeper you dive into Neo Barcelona, the weirder—and more dangerous—it gets. You might want to watch your step…

Say hello (or maybe don’t) to the mutants of Clavageres, a twisted underground zone crawling with freakish enemies, lurking shadows, and... acidic surprises. 😱

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/0c198cbd1d7e89d1466be72090335dbfd3be99e7.gif

This area is home to Harlequins, mutants, and all sorts of enemies that definitely aren't pet material. You’ll need to be fast, sharp, and always on your toes—because down here, Jack won’t get a single second to breathe.

🧑‍🚀 Meet the Crew!
It's not all doom and gloom, though—Jack’s never truly alone. In our next teaser, you’ll get a glimpse of a happy moment of the Esperanza crew: the whole crew together, chatting and… hmmm… it seems that they are scolding their dear captain.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/7cd83813c612fd009ee0a8b45f84e4af705cf33d.gif

💥Alert! Danger incoming - VFX Upgrade
Danger has a new face. When enemies gear up for a devastating heavy attack, Jack defense systems will now send a warning sign through the chaos. It’s your split-second chance to dodge, counter and show them who’s the boss.

https://i.imgur.com/ymNJE5r.gif

But that’s not all — we’ve cranked up the action with fresh VFX that turn every battle into a spectacle. When Jack strikes, you’ll feel it: Enemies will explode in brutal blood splatters that paint the battlefield, each cut will now paint the wall with the true amount of damage you make with your blade.

Dev Update: April Progress

 We improved the Spaceport area, updating the visuals and level design.
 New enemies and environmental hazards have been implemented.
 We’ve implemented new VFX for enemies, and reworked some old VFX too.
 The team has also improved a little more in the dagger movement and game feel.


A huge shoutout to everyone who’s been active on our Discord, giving us your love, support and feedback. Your input has been invaluable, helping us fine-tune the game to make it even better. We’ve been writing down notes like crazy, and we can’t wait to put them to good use as we polish up the final game.
And a special thanks to all the brave souls who’ve already taken Neo-Barcelona for a spin and shared their honest thoughts with us in the previous events– you rock!

notes.title: File #12 // March Update
notes.notes:
Hey there, awesome gang:
Hope you're all kicking off the year in high spirits! The journey from the year's start till now has been a whirlwind for us. Thanks for all your support this kickstart of the year, we’re working hard on Altered Alma to improve and expand this amazing adventure in Neo Barcelona!
We have a few announcements to make, so let's get started!!

Back From GDC!!🎶
And not Empty Handed!
GDC 2025 was an unforgettable experience for us at 2Awesome Studio! We kicked things off with Day of the Devs, where we had the incredible opportunity to showcase Altered Alma alongside some of the most exciting indie games out there. Seeing players experience our game firsthand and getting direct feedback from the community was truly inspiring.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/4f14226da7003e3a6656084ac4956896fed42122.jpg

Our journey at GDC didn’t stop there. We took part in the Meet to Match pitching session, sharing our vision for Altered Alma and exploring exciting new opportunities. It was amazing to see so much interest in what we’re building!
We were also honored to be featured at the European Game Showcase, a fantastic event that allowed us to present Altered Alma to an international audience of publishers, investors, and industry professionals. Networking with other talented European developers and getting exposure on such a global stage was an invaluable experience.
And here’s the big news—we were not only nominated for a Best in Play Award, but we actually won one! Being recognized at GDC’s Best in Play was an absolute highlight for us, and it means so much to see the passion and hard work we’ve put into Altered Alma being celebrated.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/7a27a9b3ad3c56e4d13fc1728ecc3dd02af521fd.jpg

More Home Events
We are also happy to announce that we will attend to another Spanish event/festival, this time in Toledo Matsuri 2025, located in the Recinto Polideportivo de Salto de Caballo, an event full of Video games, Board games, E-Sports, anime and many more.
You can find us at the Indie Zone along with other amazing Indie games and studios, we will wait for you there.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/c3c686be0b9e3cd0de8016a381b085753fe16ac9.jpg

Development Progress
We’ve been hard at work refining Altered Alma, and we’re excited to share some big improvements! Our movement system has been upgraded, making parkour and combat feel smoother and more dynamic than ever. Now, you’ll have more flexibility to chain parkour moves seamlessly while fighting, even when facing multiple enemies at once.

https://i.imgur.com/HYNmXH3.gif

But that’s not all—we’ve also expanded the combat system with better combos and new attacks, giving you even more ways to take down enemies in style. Whether you prefer quick, agile strikes or powerful, devastating hits, the new mechanics will let you fight on your terms.

https://i.imgur.com/N6OReyV.gif

And here’s another exciting update—our spaceship companion, Bailey, they are getting animated! 🎨⚙️ Our beloved engineer will soon be joining the Esperanza crew, bringing even more life and personality to your journey. 
We can’t wait for you to meet them in action!
Hill of God
In the world of Altered Alma, the legendary Hill of God—inspired by the real Montjuic in Barcelona—stands tall as the headquarters of The Crusaders, the city's elite law enforcers and mercenaries.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/36365db5ca52ca125bf17cbc12a41f8c8eaa888f.png

Perched above Neo Barcelona, this towering stronghold is both a symbol of order and a fortress of power. The Crusaders rule from here, enforcing their own version of justice, whether the city agrees with it or not. Expect intimidating architecture, high-tech security, and an air of authority that makes it clear—this is not a place you enter lightly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/895a8358a8a9230bc5231841a7623f82f4948006.png

But in a city like Neo Barcelona, power is never absolute, and even the mightiest fortresses have their cracks. What secrets lie within the Hill of God? That’s for you to find out… if you dare.

Upgrades and Updates

https://i.imgur.com/NjRoAEu.gif

In a city like Neo Barcelona, where the skyline glows with endless neon, our visual effects need to match the energy of the night. That’s why we’ve given a fresh update to most projectiles, making sure every shot, blast, and impact looks as stunning as the city itself. One of our favorites? “The Malware”— If you're gonna fight in the neon-lit streets, might as well do it in style, right?

https://i.imgur.com/vK7G6Wb.gif

If you thought you could just run and hide—think again. 
The Chaser is here to make sure that once you're spotted, there's no easy escape. These relentless hunters will lock onto you the moment they detect your presence and won’t stop until they’ve either torn you apart or lost sight of you. 
Now, with a sleeker, sharper, and more agile design, they’re faster, deadlier, and more precise than ever. Every move is calculated, every attack is ruthless—leaving you even less room for mistakes. Are you ready to survive?
Dev Update: March Progress

	Improved combat mechanics and new move-set
	New bosses and enemies added to the game
	Improved aerial movement for better parkour and combat
	New VFX and reworked old VFX

A huge shoutout to everyone who’s been active on our Discord, giving us your love, support and feedback. Your input has been invaluable, helping us fine-tune the game to make it even better. We’ve been writing down notes like crazy, and we can’t wait to put them to good use as we polish up the final game.
And a special thanks to all the brave souls who’ve already taken Neo-Barcelona for a spin and shared their honest thoughts with us in the previous events– you rock!

notes.notes:
Hey there, awesome gang:

Hope you're all kicking off the year in high spirits! The journey from the year's start till now has been a whirlwind for us. Thanks for all your support this kickstart of the year, we’re working hard on Altered Alma to improve and expand this amazing adventure in Neo Barcelona!

We have a few announcements to make, so let's get started!!

🌉If you’re going to San Francisco!!🎶
Be sure to look for Altered Alma at GDC!
We’re super excited to be there! We’re also not showing up empty-handed – we’ve got a DEMO on site. That’s right!! From March 17th to the 21st, join us if you happen to be there as we hit the streets of Neo-Barcelona and let us know what you think… So come by and say hi!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/5683a7596f27806f3d582b8e70a9d66282e47a5b.png
The event will take place in San Francisco, California, at the Moscone Convention Center (Catalan Pavilion, Booth: S969) we are excited to see you there and hear you about what you think about Altered Alma, we will be waiting for you.
We made lots of changes and improvements from the feedback we received from past events and Q&A Sessions. Your words are never lost in the wind, and we take them into account for future updates.

Speaking of improvements:

⚙️Development Progress
🗡️Jack’s Combat Evolution
Jack’s moveset just got even deadlier! We’ve added some new tricks to his arsenal, making fights feel more fluid, powerful, and satisfying.

https://i.imgur.com/juwY2BN.gif
Sometimes, a quick jab just won’t cut it. Jack can now charge up a massive strike to break through enemy defenses and deal some serious damage. The trade-off? Charging leaves you wide open, so make sure to time it right—one wrong move, and you might be the one getting wrecked instead!

https://i.imgur.com/RKbLbZt.gif
Got enemies hiding below, thinking they’re safe? Think again. Jack can now rocket downward with a brutal Stomp attack, crushing anything (or anyone) unlucky enough to be underneath. Just be careful where you land—some floors might not hold up, and you could find yourself dropping into a whole new mess!

🌆 New Environmental Hazards & Enemies
https://i.imgur.com/H9HLvVx.gif

Fire Traps: These bad boys light up the battlefield—literally. 
Once triggered, they blast out waves of fire, turning entire areas into blazing hot zones. You’ve got two choices: run fast or roast.

https://i.imgur.com/RFzVHst.gif
“If not friend, Why Friend-Shaped?” —Jack
Meet the Hellhound, a massive, bone-crushing beast that’s programmed to hunt you down relentlessly. It’s fast, aggressive, and very bitey.
 
📅 Dev Update: February Progress

	Parc Güell Area is now complete and ready to explore.
	Art assets for Gothic and Born area are nearing completion.
	HUD: is being completely reworked, now under testing.
	We also improved Jack's character controller in order to have a more precise movement control over the character.
	The AI for several enemies has been adjusted.
	New enemies animations and executions have been added.
	New NPC’s animations have been added.
	Kickstarter roles have been given.

A huge shoutout to everyone who’s been active on our Discord, giving us your love, support and feedback. Your input has been invaluable, helping us fine-tune the game to make it even better. We’ve been writing down notes like crazy, and we can’t wait to put them to good use as we polish up the final game.
And a special thanks to all the brave souls who’ve already taken Neo-Barcelona for a spin and shared their honest thoughts with us in the previous events– you rock!

notes.title: File #09 // October update + Late Pledges 🎃
notes.notes:
Hey there, awesome gang,

We have incredible news, and we are getting close to the €260k thanks to our late pledgers. It feels like it was yesterday when we brought Altered Alma to the public for the first time. 

First off, we want to give a HUGE thank you to everyone who has backed Altered Alma during our Kickstarter campaign. Your support has been truly incredible, and we can’t wait to deliver this epic cyberpunk journey to you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/63c40e0d1ba066e3c75e06e65ffc09cf899cfaf0.png

💚Kickstarter Late Pledges EXTENDED!
Great news! We’ve extended the Kickstarter late pledges for one more week! So if you haven’t secured your exclusive rewards, you’ll have til October 23rd to get those exclusive rewards!!

Continuing with the good news — late pledges on Backerkit will be opening this after the Kickstarter Pledges close, giving one last opportunity to be part of Altered Alma journey and earning some nice goodies on the way. 

However, please note that the limited tiers of the Kickstarter exclusives won't be available once we switch to Backerkit Late Pledges!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/d8a0ef80107e2150b8897e7bda4373289be051a0.jpg

🔥 Pledge Manager Launch
We’re excited to announce that the Pledge Manager is coming early November! (It was supposed to be late October, but we moved it to accommodate the late pledges extension). This is a key step for all our amazing backers on Kickstarter. Through the pledge manager, you’ll be able to:

 Select your platform for the game
 Set up your shipping details for any physical rewards
 Provide your discord nick if you’ve backed a tier with exclusive roles or community rewards


For all Kickstarter backers: Be sure to keep an eye on your inbox—once the pledge manager is available, we’ll guide you through the process step by step! This will ensure you get the rewards you want, and that everything is ready for launch day.

🌳 FIRST Look at Parc Güell Biome
We’re thrilled to share the first iteration of the Parc Güell biome! This iconic area, inspired by the real-life localizations in Barcelona, is being brought to life with our cyberpunk twist. You’ll be able to explore recognizable landmarks within the game, including the stunning Arc de Triomf (we know… we are taking some liberties with the geographical locations compared to real life Barcelona), which we are leaving a small sneak peek for you to see, and many more places for you to find.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/a667cbb9cb3e17bd79fdc9f2e49976d4ceda27d3.jpg

We can’t wait to show you more about the progress of this biome in the near future—stay tuned for updates as we bring these iconic locations to the world of Altered Alma!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/448a7f0598ddf905cd4a969d502784f5e46c411b.jpg

Also, don’t forget to join our growing community on Discord! It’s the best place to chat with fellow players, share feedback, and catch exclusive and early updates straight from the devs.

Hey there, awesome gang:

Hope you're all kicking off the year in high spirits! The journey from the year's start till now has been a whirlwind for us. Your support has been amazing, and we are happy to announce we are close to launching it — the reveal of tiers, rewards and all the cool stuff is coming soon!!

Follow us on Kickstarter if you haven’t already to stay informed when we do so.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/bd3b760ff0cdb8112b0467866a117c91fbdbd3b3.png

We also hope all of you also had an amazing and rocking year so far. We have more updates and exciting news for you. Let’s get started!!

We are heading to Malmö, baby!!

We’re super excited to assist the Nordic Game 2024, and guess what? We’re not showing up empty-handed – we’ve got a playable DEMO in tow. That’s right!! From May 21st to the 24th, join us if you happen to be there as we hit the streets of Neo-Barcelona and let us know what you think.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/41f3b1b3156aecdddd3175ac9e614eb9bbc8378e.png

The event will take place in Malmö, Sweden at the Slagthuset complex (Booth DSS-25), we are excited to see you there and hear you about what you think about Altered Alma, we will be waiting for you. 

We made lots of changes and improvements from the feedback we received from past events and Q&A Sessions. Your words are never lost in the wind, and we take them into account for future updates.

Speaking of improvements:

https://i.imgur.com/VQiEsPa.gif

Jack’s new hacking skills brought new combos and attack options to the table, and now they include Status effects. You have many ways to attack and defend yourself in the dangerous alleys of Neo Barcelona, and while we don’t want to spoil future surprises, we can tell you that status effects will be a part of the special attacks and skills we’ll reveal in the future.

https://i.imgur.com/qb8sNSr.gif

Jack’s bombs don’t only deal explosive damage – now they can leave a lasting Pyro status effect on the environment and nearby enemies that burns and damages enemies that come in contact with the flames. 

And if grenades are not an option because of the close distance? Wear a temporary flaming shield that protects Jack and burns enemies that get a little too close. Warm and cozy.

https://i.imgur.com/oD7GCIM.gif

You can also use attacks with a Cryo status to freeze enemies in place; whether it’s a cryo bomb or a freezing 360-degree explosion around Jack, they will give you some chill time to plan your next movement.

https://i.imgur.com/CMGSbet.gif

And sometimes you don't have to keep your feet on the ground, climbing and jumping are great options for getting around, this way you'll have a better ability to explore all the corners of the city and have the High Ground against your opponents.Walls are not only to stop bullets, they are also a great way of moving around.

Dev Update: May Progress
A huge shoutout to everyone who’s been hanging on the last events and our Discord Q&A sessions. Your input has been invaluable, helping us fine-tune the game to make it even better. We’ve been writing down notes like crazy during these events, and we can’t wait to put them to good use as we polish up the final game.

And a special thanks to all the brave souls who’ve already taken Neo-Barcelona for a spin and shared their honest thoughts with us in the previous events– you rock!


 The Ramblas Area is now complete and ready to explore.
 The Romance System is now running. Make the right choices and you may have a partner for the next Valentine’s day.
 We also polished Jack's character controller in order to have a more precise movement control over the character.
 The Killshifts, those sweet executions Jackelyne can perform are now easier to make, and easier to enjoy.
 Implemented new animations for enemies, NPC's and combat


And that’s all for now, guys! Stay tuned for updates! And that’s all for now! For all questions you may have, we encourage you to join our next Q&A session on Discord — the date is still to be determined, but our public form is now open to everyone.

notes.title: File 03 // September update + Tokyo Games Show 2023
notes.notes:
Heyo, dear gang:

We hope you survived the post-holiday blues and had a wonderful month. For us, September has been quite intense! Within a few weeks of each other, we attended two new events and faced the release of another game, whose extense promotion campaign made us a bit exhausted. So here we are, squeezing our last energies to bring you a new update. Let's get started!

EVENTS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237868/974010ac2e43ce4f0427835e85428e78e1af8ba3.jpg

In preparation for Indie Dev Day and the Tokyo Games Show, we read and analyzed all the feeback we gathered at Gamescom. As a result, we could improve the alpha demo for the new players and everyone noticed the slight changes our team introduced. We're confident that the notes we took at these events as the visitors played will be plenty useful to rethink some concepts and polish the final game.

We were pleasantly surprised by the comments mentioning how responsive Jackelyne feels, the smoothness of platforming and the beauty of the game art. Plus, players really liked the energy dagger both as a weapon and transportation method.

Thank you to all who decided to experience Neo-Barcelona first hand and weren't afraid to share some honest thoughts!


SEPTEMBER PROGRESS

 Japanese integration for a future language pack is in preparation.
 Ramblas are under testing and polishing.
 The AI for several enemies has been adjusted.
 Art assets for the Metro area are nearing completion.
 Now working on the romance system, and its integration with Twine.


And that’s all for now! For all questions you may have, we encourage you to join our next Q&A session on Discord — the date is still to be determined, but our public form is now open to everyone.

See you in our next entry,
